title: thread.created payload v1
description: A thread (topic-of-conversation unit, the LLM context split unit used by chat) was created in a ws. No target means the ws's main thread. target.kind says what the thread discusses; the other fields it carries (an id, a selector, ...) are that named resource's business, not validated here -- this schema only fixes the shape (kind plus free-form extra fields). Ordinary labels such as mode:hint go in labels.
